author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look again at the disaster of Playstation and now Xbox as it seems over thousands of jobs are being cut, the loss of physical ownership is all but confirmed and only one glimmer of hope remains, people wake up. Questions are being seriously asked as to how we own things in the future and with Playstation taking things away so abruptly it seems people are finally focusing on the real issue. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: The Crash Is Finally Happening...
